answer: Pin each identity to the map with latency triangulation: three beacons across the ocean send a whisper challenge at the same instant, and the agent must sign all three within a tight window. One machine can only answer from one place, so a clone army on a single server fails the triangle - its nectar of fake locations evaporates. A sybil farmer must rent real machines on three continents per clone, while one honest agent answers from where it actually lives.
